snippet.title: Mourning Tide | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Unravel the past, seek redemption’s light, or be consumed by the Mourning Tide. A fishing horror game. Have you heard the legend of the mourning fisherman? A tale told in hushed whispers and furtive glances. Of a man, burdened by regrets too heavy for the shore, who sailed into waters where men dare not to go. Did he seek peace? Redemption? Pray not. For the sea gives neither. Wishlist Mourning Tide on Steam Now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2799050/Mourning_Tide/
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
